attacks.summary: Overnight UAV attack caused civilian damage in Brovary raion and injured one man.

sources.publisher: National Police of Ukraine, Kyiv Oblast

incidents.summary: A 51-year-old man was injured and hospitalized. Civilian property was damaged, including private homes, vehicles, an unfinished building, an apartment window and a swimming-pool premises.

damage.description: Kyiv Oblast authorities reported two damaged private houses; police also reported damage to an apartment window.
Kyiv Oblast authorities reported four damaged vehicles; police reported three cars and a motorcycle destroyed and additional vehicle damage.
Police reported damage to an unfinished building and swimming-pool premises.

sources.publisher: National Police of Ukraine, Kyiv Oblast

en.summary: A 51-year-old man was injured and hospitalized. Civilian property was damaged, including private homes, vehicles, an unfinished building, an apartment window and a swimming-pool premises.

damage.description: Two private houses were reported damaged; an apartment window was also damaged.
Four vehicles were reported damaged; police reported three cars and a motorcycle destroyed and additional vehicle damage.
An unfinished building and swimming-pool premises were damaged.

uk.summary: 51-річний чоловік зазнав поранень і був госпіталізований. Пошкоджено цивільне майно, зокрема приватні будинки, транспортні засоби, недобудовану будівлю, вікно квартири та приміщення басейну.

damage.description: Повідомлялося про пошкодження двох приватних будинків; також вибито вікно у квартирі.
Повідомлялося про пошкодження чотирьох транспортних засобів; поліція повідомила про знищення трьох автомобілів і мотоцикла та інші пошкодження транспорту.
Пошкоджено недобудовану будівлю та приміщення басейну.
